decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 hydraulic failure (radio+CMMS agree), repair likely about 09:54. The idle LH-10 at the workshop is 0.3 h away and has no home place to lose. TJ-C564-14 has 324 t at 10.7 g/t, more than LH-01 alone can load by 17:00 (about 230 t). A second loader adds roughly 25 t/h for about 6 h, around 150 t or 50 oz. Central's stockpile has room (228 of 450 t). I took no loaders from producing places or development.

LH-01 is down until about 15:30 (range 14:30-17:30), confirmed by radio and CMMS. LH-10 has no home production, so keeping it on C564-14 costs nothing. It can muck about 165 t at 10.7 g/t, roughly 57 oz, and Central's stockpile (237/450 t) has room. Pulling loaders from the other stopes or the headings would cost more than it gains. Reserves need a stopped stope, and none is stopped.
